top_concerns: Settings are small, synthetic SFT setups with a known, nameable behavior; no RL or naturally occurring reward hacking or sycophancy despite the oversight-failure motivation
Inoculation and evaluation prompts appear tuned on the held-out metrics (best-of-N); no validation split or regret analysis for the selection heuristic
Selection heuristic is weak: correlations of 0.57-0.90 over few prompts, no CIs, fails on Qwen-2 base, and is not shown to select good prompts

Mechanism untested and conditional-policy/backdoor explanation not ruled out; IP increases compliance with undesired requests for some models (Qwen 2.5); effect brittle and decays with longer training
Limited baselines (only PTST); no comparison to persona-vector steering, gradient routing or data filtering; narrow capability evaluation
